title: Canoes of Grand Portage
lineage: Inspected the cited passages; the retained file is a paraphrased research note.

passages.note: The park describes Ojibwe birchbark, cedar and spruce-root canoes, seam sealant, family labor and fur-trade use; historic North Canoe exchange value about 25 beaver hides is not tied to the 1939 build.
